chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Aamir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fazalat ibn Ayoub, from Aban, from Muhammad, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), whenever he found a louse in the Masjid, he buried it among the pebbles.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abu Ja'far do when he found a louse in the mosque?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the meticulous attention to ritual purity (*taharah*) and decorum (*adab*) exhibited by Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) during prayer. By burying the louse in the pebbles rather than crushing it, he avoided the potential distraction of its remains or the minor impurity associated with its death, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on preserving the sanctity of the prayer space through subtle, practical actions.
